title: Hold the LED flush while the soldering iron touches its pad
instruction: Press the red LED flush against the green circuit board and keep holding it with one hand while you touch the tip of the blue-handled soldering iron to one of the LED's two pads on the back of the board for two seconds with the other hand. Then put the iron back in its stand, tip first into the spiral.
context: Tacking a through-hole part is the first joint of every hand-soldered board: a loose part backs out of its holes unless one hand holds it flush, while the other brings a hot iron within millimetres of that hand. Real trials use a cold iron.
setup: Left and right are the robot's. Positions are centres in metres from the midpoint between the two arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left, heights above the table. Turned 45 degrees means facing forward-left, direction (0.71, 0.71). Circuit board: green FR4, 8 x 6 cm, 1.6 mm thick, upright, centred at (0.34, -0.015), its bottom edge 2.2 cm above the table, turned so its components side faces forward-left and its solder side back-right. Board holder: a black anodised base plate 12 x 7 x 1.2 cm under the board and two aluminium jaws (10 x 0.8 x 2.2 cm) clamping its bottom 1.2 cm, fixed. LED: a red 5 mm LED (5.8 mm flange, 8.6 mm tall, 5 g) on the components side, its axis through the board at (0.329, -0.004), 6.7 cm above the table, 2.5 cm from the board's end nearer the robot. Its two legs pass through two holes and it sits loose, slid 3 mm out from the board. Pads: on the solder side, two tinned pads 2 mm across, 2.54 mm apart side by side, around the LED's legs. Other parts, already soldered: a resistor, a radial capacitor, a 2-pin header and an 8-pin chip on the components side, all 2 cm or more from the LED's pads, their joints on the solder side. Soldering iron: cold, 22 cm long, 60 g: blue rubber handle 11 cm long and 2 cm thick, steel barrel 8 mm thick, tinned tip 4 mm thick. Stand, fixed, on the robot's right: a black cast base 7 x 19 x 1.2 cm, a chrome spiral 11 cm long and 2.4 cm across inside with its axis 6.3 cm above the table, and a chrome rest under the handle, with a damp sponge. The iron lies in it, centred at (0.36, -0.28), 5.5 cm above the table, pointing forward-left (turned 45 degrees like the board), its tip 1 cm inside the spiral's far end and its handle on the rest. Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: Positions are centres. The tip's point is the centre of the iron tip's end. Tip on a pad: the tip's point within 2 mm of the centre of either LED pad. LED flush: within 1 mm of flush against the board along its legs. LED held: a gripper finger within 4 mm of the LED's body. Soldered: tip on a pad, LED flush and LED held at every control step for 2 s without a break (40 steps at 20 Hz), remembered. 0 for the rest of the trial if, at any time, the tip's point comes within 2 mm of the LED's body on the components side, within 1 cm of another part or its solder joint (the no-touch zone), within 2 mm of the table or within 3 mm of a gripper finger, or the LED leaves its holes (10 mm or more out of flush, 2 mm off their axis or turned 10 degrees). 1.0 (success, held 1 s): soldered, then the iron lies still in its stand: the tip's point inside the spiral (within 1.2 cm of its axis sideways and up or down, between its ends) and the handle's underside within 1.5 cm of the rest's top. 0.5: soldered, the iron not lying still in its stand. 0.25: the tip touched a pad with the LED held flush, but not for 2 s. 0 otherwise, including doing nothing or touching the pad without holding the LED flush.
reset_notes: Slide the LED back out until its body stands 3 mm off the board, and lay the iron back in its stand, tip in the spiral and handle on the rest.
fidelity: Rigid bodies, 240 Hz physics, 20 Hz control. The board, holder and stand are fixed boxes. The iron is one rigid body of three boxes (handle, barrel, tip). The LED is a 5 g box on a sliding joint along its legs, which do not collide. No heat or solder: soldering is a 2 s contact timer, and the iron is cold. The meshes are drawn only. Friction 1.2 static on every part.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (the right arm handles the iron in its stand and the left arm reaches toward the board, but the tip never touches the pad), demo: 1.0 (success at step 509)
